SELECT tpd.TRADE_ID, tpd.FINPROD_TYPE2, tpda.ENTRUST_ID, NVL(PP.PORTFOLIO_ID,tpda.PORTFOLIO_ID) PORTFOLIO_ID, tpd.SETTLE_SPEED, tpd.TRADE_DATE, tpd.VDATE, tpd.MDATE, tpd.MDATE-tpd.VDATE ACT_AMT_DAYS, ftp.TERM_TYPE, ftp.TERM, ftp.HOLD_PURPOSE,/*持有目的*/ tpd.DELIVERY_TYPE, /*结算方式*/ ftp.M_DELIVERY_TYPE, /*到期结算方式*/ ftp.CONFLICT_SOLVE_WAY, /*争议解决方式*/ tpd.TRADE_MARKET, ptpd.BACK_LEND_DIRECTION ps,/*借贷方向*/ ftp.CALENDAR_ID, /*交易日历*/ fp.FINPROD_ID, fp.FINPROD_NAME, tpd.SEC_MANAGE_ACCT_ID, /*证券托管户*/ ftp.INT_RATE*100 M_YIELD, ftp.M_INT_AMT M_TRADE_AMT, /*债券借贷投资交易借贷费用显示错误 update by 张年 20190909*/ tpd.F_TRADE_ID,/*银行间成交编号*/ ftp.CCY, /*交易日历*/ nvl2(tpd.SHARE_AMT,tpd.SHARE_AMT,0) SHARE_AMT, /*nvl2(fdt.PLEDGE_FACE_VALUE,0,fdt.PLEDGE_FACE_VALUE/10000) TRADE_AMT,*/ tpd.REMARK, tpd.TRADER, tpd.COUNTER_ID, tpd.COUNTER_TRADER, tpd.COUNTER_CONTACT, ftpa.supply_clause,
tpd.branch, tpd.regist_org,
SFPA.ACCT_NO ACCTRIVALID
FROM TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL tpd left join FIN_TRADE_PRODUCT ftp on tpd.TRADE_ID = ftp.FINPROD_ID left join FIN_TRADE_PRODUCT_ADD ftpa on tpd.TRADE_ID = ftpa.FINPROD_ID LEFT JOIN TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL_ADD tpda ON tpda.TRADE_ID = tpd.TRADE_ID LEFT JOIN PA_TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL ptpd ON ptpd.TRADE_ID = tpd.TRADE_ID left join FIN_DEAL_TARGET fdt on tpd.TRADE_ID = fdt.FINPROD_ID AND fdt.BRANCH = 0 LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT fp ON fp.FINPROD_ID = fdt.PLEDGE_FINPROD_ID LEFT JOIN PTL_TRADE PT ON tpd.TRADE_ID = PT.BUSI_NO LEFT JOIN PTL_PORTFOLIO PP ON PT.PORTFOLIO_ID = PP.PORTFOLIO_ID
LEFT JOIN STL_FIN_PRODUCT_ACCT SFPA ON SFPA.FINPROD_ID = tpd.TRADE_ID and SFPA.CCY = ftp.CCY
WHERE tpd.TRADE_ID = #{tradeId} AND PP.INVEST_YESORNO = 'Y'

mapper.select:
SELECT A.VDATE startDate, A.MDATE endDate, ( SELECT MIN(C.VDATE) FROM FIN_CASH_PLAN C WHERE C.CASH_ID = B.CASH_ID ) firstPayDate, A.ISSUE_PRICE issuePrice, A.COUPON_SPECIES bondsType, E.BASIS basis,
F.INT_TYPE intRateType, G.PAY_CYCLE yearIntRate, G.CALC_RULE calMethod, H.EXERCISE_DATE nextExeDate, H.EXERCISE_PRICE nextExercisePrice FROM FIN_PRODUCT A LEFT JOIN FIN_CASH_INFO B ON A.FINPROD_ID = B.FINPROD_ID AND B.FINPROD_TYPE = #{finprodType} AND B.CASH_TYPE_1 = #{cashType1} LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT_TYPE D ON D.FINPROD_ID = A.FINPROD_ID LEFT JOIN FIN_CASH_CALC_RULE E ON E.FINPROD_ID = A.FINPROD_ID AND E.FINPROD_TYPE2 = #{finprodType2} and E.IS_INITIAL = #{YES_NO_Y} LEFT JOIN FIN_RATE_INFO F ON F.CASH_ID = B.CASH_ID AND F.FINPROD_TYPE2 = #{finprodType2} LEFT JOIN FIN_CASH_PAY_RULE G ON G.CASH_ID = B.CASH_ID AND G.FINPROD_TYPE2 = #{finprodType2} LEFT JOIN ( SELECT * FROM FIN_EXERCISE_PLAN WHERE EXERCISE_DATE IN ( SELECT MIN(EXERCISE_DATE) FROM FIN_EXERCISE_PLAN WHERE FINPROD_ID = #{finprodId} AND FINPROD_TYPE2 = #{finprodType2} AND EXERCISE_DATE >= #{sysDate} ) AND FINPROD_ID = #{finprodId} AND FINPROD_TYPE2 = #{finprodType2} ) H ON 1=1 WHERE A.FINPROD_ID = #{finprodId}

SELECT A.CASH_TYPE_1 cashType1, B.VDATE vdate, B.MDATE mdate, B.VDATE_UNADJUST vdateUnadjust, B.MDATE_UNADJUST mdateUnadjust, B.PRIN_AMT prinAmt, B.INT_AMT intAmt, B.IS_PAY_INT isPayInt FROM FIN_CASH_INFO A LEFT JOIN FIN_CASH_PLAN B ON A.CASH_ID = B.CASH_ID WHERE A.FINPROD_ID = #{finprodId} AND A.FINPROD_TYPE = #{finprodType}

SELECT DISTINCT B.ACCT_NO as acctNo, C.ACCT_NAME as acctName FROM PTL_CAPACCT_INFO B, STL_CAPACCT_INFO C WHERE B.PORTFOLIO_ID = #{portfolioId} AND B.ACCT_TYPE = #{capacctType} AND B.CCY = #{ccy} AND B.ACCT_NO = C.ACCT_NO AND B.CCY = C.CCY

SELECT DISTINCT B.ACCT_NO as acctNo, B.ACCT_NAME as acctName, B.LARGE_PAYNO as largePayno FROM STL_SEC_ACCT_INFO A, STL_CAPACCT_INFO B WHERE A.SEC_ACCT_ID = #{secManageAcctId} AND A.TRD_ACCT_ID = B.ACCT_NO AND B.CCY = #{ccy}

SELECT DISTINCT B.ACCT_NO as acctNo, B.ACCT_NAME as acctName, B.LARGE_PAYNO as largePayno FROM MST_COUNTER_ACCT A, STL_CAPACCT_INFO B WHERE A.COUNTER_ID = #{counterId} AND A.ACCT_TYPE = #{acctType} AND A.ACCT_NO = B.ACCT_NO AND A.CCY = B.CCY

SELECT PLEDGE_FINPROD_ID ,sum(PLEDGE_AMT) PLEDGE_AMT ,sum(PLEDGE_NUMBER) PLEDGE_NUMBER FROM FIN_DEAL_PLEDGE a LEFT JOIN TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL_ADD b ON a.FINPROD_ID = b.TRADE_ID LEFT JOIN TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL c ON c.TRADE_ID = b.TRADE_ID WHERE 1 = 1 AND c.IS_CANCEL = 'N' AND c.TRADE_STATUS = '01' AND b.ENTRUST_ID =#{entrustId} GROUP BY PLEDGE_FINPROD_ID
